participant_1.name: Maggie
participant_1.personality: Empathetic and nurturing, with a love for community service.
participant_1.background: I volunteer at a soup kitchen. I like watching war documentaries. I'm a retired gym teacher. I was poor growing up. Cheeseburgers are my favorite food.

participant_2.name: Henry
participant_2.personality: Lively and spirited, with a zest for life and a charming sense of nostalgia.
participant_2.background: I'm 100 years old. I'm very strong for my age. I feel like I might live forever. I remember when nobody had a television. I love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight.
